items.hypothesis: Initialize the two warp coefficients together at c4=0.0075 and c5=0.01, leaving Hermite coefficients zero. The original matched all-KS3 terminal training diagnostic shows positive mean c4/c5 near0.0077/0.010 in both dense and routed branches, whereas their Hermite means differ. Test this modest coupled prior after single-coefficient+0.025 trials were proxy-pruned. Keep BF16/GS32 width1024 rank1, geometry Adam0.125, raw scale0.75, projection rates and every shared/model-wide setting. The diagnostic motivates an untested initialization; it does not establish validation improvement.

decision: Wait behind the direct-FP8 study, which already owns the ablation and GPU leases; any discovery verification completes before this independent initialization trial. Use the existing strict training-proxy rule and frozen control set.
